Waterberg on fire

By: Anina Peens | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
What do you do when a fire approaches you at 60 kilometres an hour? you leave everything behind and run... but what happens when you return to the ashes of what was once your entire life?

Unique Selling Point:
Some say it's the worst fires to hit the Limpopo province in over 80 years. Scores of farms, houses and businesses burnt to the ground while we get a first hand account of a couple who escaped their house with the clothes on their backs.




Summary:
In the Free state, an 80 year old woman burnt to death in her farm house amidst raging fires destroying thousands of hectares in the province. Scores of houses burnt down in Pretoria and surroundings and even as Far East as Mpumalanga. But in Limpopo, farmers say, they have never seen fires this big. Some fire walls stretched over 300 meters and raged for five consecutive days, leaving everything in its wake, in ashes. When a couples house caught fire and they got stuck inside, they frantically called family to say their last goodbyes. But somehow they escaped to safety and live to tell the tale.


Further information:
A man and woman escaped the fire in their house, by absolute mercy. A fire, running at over 60km/per hour hit them on Sunday in winds that the province haven’t recorded in years. We have the benefit of playing voice notes that indicates exactly what they have been through. They are small stock farmers; they had 100 pigs, and only 8 is left, 80 chickens, only 5 left. They literally lost everything. The woman says there was nothing she could do but run… it was like seeing a hurricane come, like in the movies.

The fires around Vaalwater are still ongoing and firefighters are still at work.

The Waterberg is an exceptionally interesting natural wonder. It has a very thin layer of sand/soil in which plats grow. That is why the trees and shrubs found there, only grow there, and then in turn attract certain bird and animal life. A fire disturbs this ecosystem and the soil is removed from the rock. It can take up to 300 years for life here, to recover.

There seems to be not enough awareness on the importance of complying to national veld and forest fire act. The bushveld is a tourism hub and many city dwellers have weekend farms. Many don’t do fire preparation in July when barriers should be burnt. When fires break out this time of year, the lack of these barriers creates running fires, in one instance over the weekend, there was a 300 meter fire wall… this means, an ongoing massive flame, spanning 300 meters. If some of these weekend farmers had barriers, it would’ve blocked the fire.

2 nights accommodation and fuel expense

Modimolle and Bela Bela

Jy bid vir genade vir jou siel op daai oomblik want jy weet nie, waantoe gaan jy? Oral waar kyk om jou is vuur.

no one could stop the fire.

SUPER@ WILLEM CROUSE: FPA MODIMOLE

Dis die slegste vuur wat ons nog gehad het in die Waterberg

SUPER: JAYBEE BOYSE
SOURCE: C0174

van darkness comes light and from light comes darkness. Ons is nou deur die donkerte, so die lig moet nou weer skyn uit die donker uit.


END

PART 1

VO
Wildfires…
A common site after winter - but this year the odds were against farmers.

In the bushveld the fiercest fires in two decades were recorded…

Nearly 100 000 hectares of veld in Limpopo were wiped out and in some cases it will take years to recover.

SUPER@ WILLEM CROUSE: FPA MODIMOLE
SOURCE: C0050
02:13:37:12
elke jaar het ons lang vure, weekvure en goed maar hierdie jaar was anders was ons het ‘n vroee ryp gehad en met die vroeer ryp het baie goed gevrek voor die tyd…en ons het vroee weerlig gehad wat ons nie sommer het nie.

VO
When the fires hit Modimolle, Willem Crause from the fire protection association or FPA worked day and night, fighting four fires at the same time.

SUPER@ WILLEM CROUSE: FPA MODIMOLE
SOURCE: FX3_1729
20:17:02:08
Jy sit fisies lewens in gevaar om dit te probeer keer sodat ander mense nie kan seerkry en kan doodbrand nie.

VO
The flames burned over 18 metres high.

SUPER@ WILLEM CROUSE: FPA MODIMOLE
SOURCE: C0050
02:14:27:10
Ons het met winde gewerk van tussen 23 tot 65 kilometer per uur.

VO
SUGGESTED CHANGE: – 2 october
In the Waterberg region - the heart of the bushveld - teams are still fighting fires non-stop.
Just 70kms away – as we arrive in the Modimole area – the fires are contained…

The fires in Modimole area are contained at our arrival but just 70 kilometres away, when entering the Waterberg area, teams were fighting non stop in Vaalwater, the heart of the bushveld.

SOURCE:
CLIP: C0070 of 0081
02:49:01:14
This is seriously off the beaten track and part of fighting the fire is actually getting access to the fire for these firefighters and we have been driving for over an hour, hour and a half over a landscape that is practically rock to get to a fire that we could see from the main road.

VO
We finally arrive at a game farm that has been burning for 11 days. Farm coordinator, Andra Hennop and her team of farm workers haven't had any sleep. She takes us to a burning mountain, as we’re warned not to navigate ourselves amidst fires that run between 30 and 40 kilometres per hour.

ANDRA NEL: FARM MANAGER
SOURCE: C0080
03:00:23:21
Dis nogal emosioneel want elke dag dink jy, vandag, dis nou die laaste dag… dan kan ons hom net monitor en dan is dit verby.

VO
Farmers came from across the region to help.

ANDRA NEL: FARM MANAGER
SOURCE: C0080
02:56:30:08
Ek vat maar die mense, ek gaan sluit die hekke oop so ek probeer vir almal water gee.

VO
We are taken to the opposite side of a mountain, covered in fire. To stop it, it has to be blocked from the side that's not burning.

SUPER@ WILLEM CROUSE: FPA MODIMOLE
SOURCE: C0102
03:20:55:16
STENETTE: NOTE VAN LEZANNE: SY BEGIN KLINK RANDOM, SO SIT MY VRAAG IN SODAT DIT MEER CONVERSATIONAL KLINK
Willem: Om ‘n beheerde brand uit te oefen voor die groot vuur wat afkom van die anderkant af. Ons doen ‘n back burn van die pad af om seker te maak daai vuur hardloop nie voor ons na ‘n deel toe wat nie gebrand het nie.
Anina: so daai vuur kom oor en hardloop in die vuur vas en hy gaan dood. So youre fighting fire with fire.
Willem: nie altyd moontlik nie.. elke vuur moet bestuur word. Jy slaan nie ‘n vuur dood nie, jy bestuur hom dood.

VO
FPA’s dispatch working on fire teams are funded by the government.

SUPER@ WILLEM CROUSE: FPA MODIMOLE
SOURCE: C0059
02:35:32:10
Dis ‘n werkskeppingsprogram wat hulle begin het baie jare terug wat ‘n baie baie goeie program is, wat verseker werk.


SUPER@ WILLEM CROUSE: FPA MODIMOLE
SOURCE: C0102
Voor is die ou met die drip torche wat aansteek, net na hom is die ou met die water, die knapsack, hy spyt en bring net die vlamme laer en daarna kom die vlappe en die vlappe maak die vuur dood.

VO
They work alongside volun teers, like farmers, who come to help, but most don’t have the correct protective gear.

BESEERDE OU BY VUUR
SOURCE: C0100 /C0108
03:17:26:16
Anina: dis nie ‘n klank wat jy van hou om te hoor nie ne?
Gideon: ek hou nie van hom as hy so naby is nie.
Anina: Wat het gebeur?
Gideon: ek was agter op die bakkie besig om water op die vuur te spyt hier langs die pad en op een stuk toe draai die wind skielik, met die het ek nou skade opgedoen.

VO
What made this year's fires so dangerous was its speed.

SUPER@ WILLEM CROUSE: FPA MODIMOLE
SOURCE: FX3_1729
20:19:46:00
Ons het dit verwag maar ons het nie die verwag nie. Hierdie was vinnig.

VO
It took many by surprise.

PART 2

UPSOUND: JAYBEE VOICENOTE
“Ek kannie ‘n pin drop stuur nie, dis die laaste plaas op Rietspruit, extension 10, ons is vasgevang tussen die vuur, mense, laat die Here ons genadig wees, ek dink nie ons kom uit die een uit nie.

VO
This voice note was sent minutes after Jaybee and Carien Booyse’s house burnt down. They didn't think they'd live to tell the story.

SUPER@ CARINE BOOYSE
SOURCE: FX3_1766
20:44:00:10
Ek het regtig gedink ek gaan dit nie daar uit maak nie, ek het vrede daarmee gemaak. Ek was reg om te gaan. Ek het geweet ek gaan versmoor voordat ek gaan brand.

VO
When the fire came, Carien was in the kitchen of their farm house just outside Modimole.

SUPER@ CARINE BOOYSE
SOURCE: FX3_1766
20:41:53:06
In ‘n kwessie van tien minute toe is die vlamme al daar.

VO
At the time, Jaybee was on a neighbouring farm, fighting fire. Realising the flames were on their way to their house, he rushed home to his wife.

SUPER: JAYBEE BOYSE
SOURCE: C0174
04:52:34:03
Ek het die bakkie deur die fence gejaag en ek het hier op die regterkant tot ‘n stillstand gekom. Want toe het ek nie meer brieke nie. En ek het die bakkie teen die boom laat staan en toe hoor ek my vrou skree daar agter in die hoek.

SUPER@ CARINE BOOYSE
SOURCE: FX3_1766
20:45:43:07
Toe ek die bakkie hoor, want ek het hom nie gesien nie, toe was daar klein bietjie verligting gewees. As jy saam met iemand deur dit gaan, dis bietjie makliker maar as jy op jou eie is… en nog nooit in so ervaring gewees nie. Jou brein dis asof hy met jou rond speel.

SUPER: JAYBEE BOYSE
SOURCE: C0174
04:58:21:11
Jy moet die besluit neem, red jy jouself, red jy jou plaas, red jy jou diere? Want wat verloor jy?

SUPER@ CARINE BOOYSE
SOURCE: FX3_1766
20:47:20:18
Die vuur is om jou, die rook is om jou maar jy weet nie presies waars die pad nie. Want jy kannie sien nie, jy kannie eers die stuurwiel in die bakkie sien nie, jy ry nou maar waar jy ry. Toe se ek naderhand vir hom, draai terug. En ek het sy hand gevat e nek het vir hom gese, dis ok. Ons gaan ok wees.

VO
After Jaybee’s heart wrenching voice notes, his sister finally came to their rescue.

SUPER@ CARINE BOOYSE
SOURCE: FX3_1766
20:50:39:17
Toe se ek vir hom kom ons sit net hier, dit is toe ons die ligte sien en toe hulle ons kom haal.

VO
There is nothing left of their farm house but the Booyses are determined to stay.

SUPER: JAYBEE BOYSE
SOURCE: C0174
04:49:53:01
Nou gaan ons herbou wat ons verloor het. Ek weet nog nie hoe nie…

VO
While all this was happening, the hottest fire recorded in the area burnt the surrounding Likhama game reserve to ashes.
The only thing left…an eerie silence.

SUPER@ WILLEM CROUSE: FPA MODIMOLE
SOURCE: FX3_1729
20:14:16:23
Geen lewe nie, geen voellewe nie, geen diere naby in sig nie, hier is geen voeding vir hulle naby nie, so geen water. So ja dit is die stilte wat ons beleef op die oomblik en dit is hoe hy lyk vir die volgende 50 60 duisend hektar…

VO
It was the same fate for the world renowned Shambala Private game reserve, about an hour’s drive from Likhama.

SUPER@ LOUIS PRIGGE: LODGE MANAGER
SOURCE: CLIP 1720
20:03:49:07
The bad thing about this fire is that at one stage you realise that it’s not just fighting the fire and that you won’t stop the fire but you have to keep yourself and your people safe, protect animals and protect infrastructure because there is nothing else than you can do.

VO
General manager Louis Prigge says, most of the 10 thousand hectares burnt in just over 9 hours.

SUPER@ LOUIS PRIGGE: LODGE MANAGER
SOURCE: CLIP 1720
20:07:30:08
Some of it will not recover and its fine, its part of life and it’s the circle of life.

VO
If the name Shambala sounds familiar, its because it recently featured on Carte Blanche. We covered the retirement of the zoo elephant Charlie, now called Duma in September. Shambala is his new home.

UPSOUND OF PREVIOUS STORY STRAP: SEP 2024

VO
Management does not allow any media near him so he can retire in peace.
Louis says firefighters managed to stop the fire and contain it around Duma’s enclosure.

SUPER@ LOUIS PRIGGE: LODGE MANAGER
SOURCE: CLIP 1720
20:09:49:10
he is doing really well. At the beginning it was a stressful situation, we were not sure how he was gonna react, but he was really really fine. There was a lot of smoke, but he was fine.

VO
It took Louis a few days to do a census of other animals lost on the farm, while the rest of farmers in the Waterberg area are also still calculating losses. Altogether nearly 70 thousand hectares were lost in the Waterberg and this number could rise as fires in the mountains and valleys can still smoulder for up to three weeks.


PROMOS

PROMO 1
VO
Not a lot of people live to tell the story after being trapped in a raging fire.
SUPER@ CARINE BOOYSE
SOURCE: FX3_1766
20:45:20:18
Jy bid vir jou siel, jy bid dat die Here jou genadig gaan wees.

VO
In late September, some of the most devastating fires ever, were recorded in the Bushveld.
SUPER@ CARINE BOOYSE
SOURCE: FX3_1766
20:48:38:11
Daar is nie ‘n beskrywing om vir iemand te beskryf hoe hierdie voel nie.
SUPER@ CARINE BOOYSE
SOURCE: FX3_1766
20:48:12:13
As jy jou oë toemaak dan sien jy hoe kom daai vlamme om jou en hoe brand jy.


PROMO 2

VO
Raging fires in Limpopo destroyed thousands of hectares of bushveld.
SUPER@ WILLEM CROUSE: FPA MODIMOLE
SOURCE: C0050
02:20:30:00
Alles is verwoes. Ons kyk altyd na die conservation gedeelte, die bome, die gras, die bosse, maar ons dink nooit aan die skilpad en die miere nie, goed wat nie kan wegkom vir vuur nie”
VO
As some farmers are slowly lifting their heads from the ashes, losses are calculated after two consecutive weeks of runaway wildfires.

PROMO 3
VO
Farmers in the Waterberg are desperate for rain after violent fires wiped out thousands of hectares.
SUPER@ WILLEM CROUSE: FPA MODIMOLE
SOURCE: C0062
02:42:02:01
Baie van hierdie groot bome gaan nie weer groei nie, met die hitte van die vuur wat hier aangekom het.
VO
It was the hottest and fastest fire ever recorded in the Waterberg area of Limpopo.
SUPER@ WILLEM CROUSE: FPA MODIMOLE
SOURCE: FX3_1729
20:19:46:00
Ons het dit verwag maar ons het nie die verwag nie. Hierdie was vinnig.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): What do you do when a fire approaches you at 60 kilometres an hour? you leave everything behind and run... but what happens when you return to the ashes of what was once your entire life?
metadata.Unique Selling Point: Some say it's the worst fires to hit the Limpopo province in over 80 years. Scores of farms, houses and businesses burnt to the ground while we get a first hand account of a couple who escaped their house with the clothes on their backs.
metadata.Summary: In the Free state, an 80 year old woman burnt to death in her farm house amidst raging fires destroying thousands of hectares in the province. Scores of houses burnt down in Pretoria and surroundings and even as Far East as Mpumalanga. But in Limpopo, farmers say, they have never seen fires this big. Some fire walls stretched over 300 meters and raged for five consecutive days, leaving everything in its wake, in ashes. When a couples house caught fire and they got stuck inside, they frantically called family to say their last goodbyes. But somehow they escaped to safety and live to tell the tale.
metadata.Further information: A man and woman escaped the fire in their house, by absolute mercy. A fire, running at over 60km/per hour hit them on Sunday in winds that the province haven’t recorded in years. We have the benefit of playing voice notes that indicates exactly what they have been through. They are small stock farmers; they had 100 pigs, and only 8 is left, 80 chickens, only 5 left. They literally lost everything. The woman says there was nothing she could do but run… it was like seeing a hurricane come, like in the movies. The fires around Vaalwater are still ongoing and firefighters are still at work. The Waterberg is an exceptionally interesting natural wonder. It has a very thin layer of sand/soil in which plats grow. That is why the trees and shrubs found there, only grow there, and then in turn attract certain bird and animal life. A fire disturbs this ecosystem and the soil is removed from the rock. It can take up to 300 years for life here, to recover. There seems to be not enough awareness on the importance of complying to national veld and forest fire act. The bushveld is a tourism hub and many city dwellers have weekend farms. Many don’t do fire preparation in July when barriers should be burnt. When fires break out this time of year, the lack of these barriers creates running fires, in one instance over the weekend, there was a 300 meter fire wall… this means, an ongoing massive flame, spanning 300 meters. If some of these weekend farmers had barriers, it would’ve blocked the fire.
